desc:
We have an update, here is what's new 🚀:
👾 You can now play as Roblox avatars in the Hub.
🎟️ Improved rewards in the Season Pass.
⏳ Daily rewards are now endless and can contain Season Pass points.
🔎Each location outside of the Hub has pieces of a hidden promo code.  Collect them all to get a prize!

2-on-2 basketball, Playgrounds style! 

🏀 Dozens of unlockable characters, each with their own strengths, weaknesses and special abilities for big dunks and bigger wins 

🏀 Dress up your characters with officially NBA licensed jerseys from all of your favorite teams 

🏀 Earn card packs which can grant you experience, item boosts, outfits and even new characters 

🏀 Play, hang out and discover the secrets of the city in each of the 5 real world locations 

🏀 Earn free rewards through daily log-in bonuses, quests, and season pass progress 

🏀 Live the hoops life, see your name at the top of the leaderboards and reach the prestigious Champion League
